rule_title: TTP T1053.005 - SMBExec: scheduled task executing batch file from Windows Temp
description: Detects Event 4698 (task created) where the TaskContent XML shows a command executing a .bat file from the Windows Temp directory, running as SYSTEM (S-1-5-18). The observed task 'smbservice' ran C:\WINDOWS\Temp\MpCmdRun.bat — a disguised batch relay.
